name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; 'scroll_text_screen_up_by_lines' accurately captures the function's role (cylinder-scroll the text-cinematic background buffer up by N lines) and its dual-mode line-count-driven design (_by_lines). No address residue in the name. Used exclusively for the chapter-0x17 / chapter-24-end text-scroll cinematic, so 'text_screen' is apt. Domain=graphics, but the existing name omits the explicit domain token; it is already established/consistent with the codebase and unambiguous, so keep.
purpose: Dual-mode helper that either records the pending scroll line-count (Mode A) or performs a cylinder scroll-up of the static background buffer by that pending count (Mode B), driving the FD2 text-scroll credit-roll cinematic.
logic_summary: param != 0 (Mode A): store low byte of param into data_fd2_graphics_text_scroll_pending_line_count and return (pre-arms the next scroll). param == 0 (Mode B): N = pending count (read unsigned byte); malloc(N*0x138) scratch; copy bottom N rows (rows 0xC0-N..0xBF) of the 0xC0-line x 0x138-byte/line static bg buffer into scratch; for i=0xBF-N down to 0 memmove row[i] -> row[i+N] (shift down by N, content visually moves up); paste saved bottom N rows back at the top (rows 0..N-1) to complete the cylinder; free scratch. __CHK(0x18) stack-probe prologue is compiler-injected.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Dual-purpose line count. Nonzero = Mode A: number of rows to record as the pending scroll count (only low byte kept). Zero = Mode B: trigger an actual cylinder scroll-up by the previously recorded pending count.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_1 (no descriptive meaning). The argument is a line count / mode selector; 'lines' (already used in src/) describes it. Recorded only; Stage 2 applies the rename to the Ghidra prototype.

returns.semantics: No return value. Effect is either updating the pending line-count state (Mode A) or mutating the static background buffer in place (Mode B).

reads_globals: data_fd2_graphics_text_scroll_pending_line_count (0x51A10, read unsigned byte in Mode B)
data_fd2_graphics_static_bg_buffer_ptr (0x53AFF, base of the 0xC0-line x 0x138-byte scroll buffer)
writes_globals: data_fd2_graphics_text_scroll_pending_line_count (0x51A10, stored as byte in Mode A)
data_fd2_graphics_static_bg_buffer_ptr buffer contents (in-place memmove in Mode B; the pointer itself is not reassigned)
notes: Verified across 4 sources (plate + decompile + disassemble + 3 caller decompiles). Disassembly confirms PUSH 0x18/CALL __CHK, CMP [ESP+0xc],0; JZ (Mode A vs B), MOV AL/[0x51A10] byte store, MOVZX unsigned reads, IMUL *0x138, malloc/memmove(x3)/free, signed JGE loop counter in EBX. Source dialog.c (lines 1139-1165) matches the binary exactly; no logic divergence. Caller semantics confirmed: chapter_24_end Mode A with cumulative line 2..14 then composite path triggers Mode B; composite_battle_tile_map (chapter 0x17) and load_chapter_background_layers (chapter 0x17) call Mode B with 0. Source comment header says '(3 callers)' = 3 distinct caller functions (4 call sites total since chapter_24_end calls twice); kept as-is (distinct-function convention, not incorrect). Static initial value at 0x51A10 = 0x01 confirmed via read_memory, matching src '= 1'. Param name param_1 is the live Ghidra name; src already uses 'lines'.
